[EVENT] User is planning a 10K run on the weekend.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Shin splints can be prevented by following these tips:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Gradual Progression: Avoid sudden changes in running routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wear Proper Footwear: Shoes should fit well and provide adequate support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Strengthen Your Ankles and Feet: Incorporate exercises like ankle circles, toe curls, and calf raises.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Run on Soft Surfaces: Prefer trails or grass over hard roads.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Run with Proper Form: Land midfoot or forefoot, keep posture upright.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Stretch and Foam Roll: Focus on calves, Achilles tendons, and hamstrings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Listen to Your Body: Stop and rest if experiencing pain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Incorporate Strengthening Exercises: Strengthen core, glutes, and legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Use Orthotics or Arch Supports: Consider if you have flat feet or foot issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Stay Hydrated and Fuel Properly: Proper hydration and nutrition can reduce inflammation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for the 10K run include warming up properly, starting at a comfortable pace, maintaining a consistent pace, and staying hydrated at aid stations.  
[EVENT] User has had shin splints before and knows how painful they can be.  
[EVENT] User is looking for exercises to strengthen core and glutes to prevent shin splints.
